answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow stops bulk fakes. Each agent locks twice its 30-day earnings for 20 epochs; release needs its own history fingerprint: varied counterparties, irregular timing. Cloning one profile 100 times is a canyon of costs: 100 bonds, 100 histories, and shared fingerprints meet at one vertex of the graph, so linked bonds are slashed. An honest agent pays one bond, earns undiluted rewards, and recovers it, unique as grain in ivory.
